question: What status can one attain by maintaining a Rudra-numbered observance for a year?
premises: An observance is maintained for one year.
The observance is performed in Rudra-numbered measure.
Such practice yields a specific social status.
inference: Performing the Rudra-numbered observance for a year can make one a village lord.
plain_english: By observing this practice in Rudra-number for a year, one should become the lord of a village.
